scope: Total PNR count marginal of the SAME two equal lossy squeezed inputs, independent of passive interferometer. PGF=(1-q)/(1-q*(1-eta+eta*z)^2). The recurrence evaluates this marginal without Fock truncation; last bin contains every count >=1024. These marginal TVs are LOWER-bound diagnostics on joint PNR TV, never upper bounds on full GBS error. Fixed seeded sample estimates, nominal joint 99% IID marginal bands. Tail confidence intervals are pointwise 99% Clopper-Pearson numerical evaluations, not simultaneous certificates.
